segments.text: The cool and isolated, "Academy's" strongest student council president.
Because she possesses extraordinary, superhuman strength, others tend to keep distance from her.
She struggles with understanding the feelings of others, so she has very few friends.
Believing that if someone weak is going to get hurt, it should be her—the strong one—who takes the blow instead, she prefers to take on missions completely alone.
She possesses an anti-reality internal organ known as the "Indigo Heart" (藍の心臓), and her life is being targeted by the Houzuki family of mages.
B.E.G.
Look Upon the Rubble (瓦礫を見ろ)
A pile bunker that stops the time of any object it touches.
Combined with Yoruno Sakura's already extraordinary physical capabilities, this is an ultimate "strongest" ability where even the slightest touch means checkmate for the opponent.
Translated from official website
クールで孤高な“学園”最強の生徒会長。
人並み外れた力を持つため、周りから距離を取られている。
他人の気持ちを考える事が苦手で、友達は少ない。
弱い誰かが傷つくぐらいなら、強い自分が傷つくべきと考えているため、単独での任務を好む。
“藍の心臓”と呼ばれる反現実の内臓を保有しており、魔術師一家『崩月家』に命を狙われている。

触れた対象の時を止めるパイルバンカー。
夜乃桜自身の身体能力がずば抜けて高い上、
少しでも触れられたら詰みという、最強の能力。
「あんまり、得意じゃないの。他人を慰めるとか」
An upbeat, high-tension, and proactively romantic kouhai girl.
Her favorite things are romance reality TV shows. Her least favorite things are pill bugs.
She is highly social and cooperative—a total monster when it comes to communication skills.

Though she has never actually been in love before, a boy (Houzuki Enju) who perfectly matches her ideal image of "If I were to date someone, I'd want a guy like this~" just happened to move in next door.
She is deeply interested in Enju and is eager to become close with him.
However, she doesn't know yet what kind of secrets are hidden beneath his surface.
B.E.G.
Red Blade (赤刀)
A chainsaw that tears targets into pieces and restores them back to their original state.
The objects chopped to pieces suffer no actual harm, and their fundamental properties are preserved.
She can even sever her own arm and control it remotely.
Translated from official website
アッパーでハイテンションな、恋に積極的な後輩女子。
好きなものは恋愛リアリティ番組。嫌いなものはダンゴムシ。
社会性と協調性が高く、コミュニケーション能力の化け物。
今まで恋愛をしたことはないが、『付き合うならこーゆー男の子が良いなー』とイメージしていた男子（崩月槐）がお隣に引っ越してきた。
槐に対して興味津々で、仲良くなりたがっている。
彼の裏に何が隠されているのか、彼女はまだ知らない。

segments.text: A proud young lady of noble birth. She possesses immense pride and hates to lose.
She has a deeply caring nature with the disposition of an older sister.
Once she takes a liking to someone, she just can't help but fuss over and take care of them.
While she is a beautiful and elegant young woman, it seems there is some sort of secret regarding her family home...?
If you follow her, you will likely never lose your way.
She possesses a certain kind of charisma that draws people in.
B.E.G.
Covenant of the Rose (薔薇の盟約)
A homing rapier that multiplies as it takes more harm or damage.
The longer a battle drags on, the stronger it becomes, executing both offense and defense flawlessly.
An ability born from the sheer will to protect what is precious to her at all costs.
Translated from official website
誇り高き貴族の少女。プライド激高で負けず嫌い。
面倒見が良い性格で、お姉ちゃん気質。
１度好きになった人に対しては、お世話が焼きたくて仕方がない。
美しく気品のある少女だが、なんだか実家の方には秘密があるみたいで……？
彼女に付いていけば、間違った道に行くことはないだろう。
人を惹きつける、ある種のカリスマを持っている。

大切なものを必ず護るという意思の能力。
「――誇りを損なう相手とは、バトルだわ！」
Houzuki Enju's little sister. She is tall and boasts a model-like physique.
Her primary role is acting as Enju's assistant, and she is constantly keeping an eye on him.
While she completely lacked talent as a mage, her physical capabilities are high.
Because she knows her older brother is bound to the Houzuki family on her account, she has firmly resolved to take Enju's side no matter what happens.
She has an extreme brother complex, yet she never lets her romantic feelings for him leak out.
She refers to herself as a "little sister ninja maid", but what exactly a ninja maid is supposed to be remains a mystery.
Magic Tool
Cursed Blade "Zankyou" (妖刀『残響』)
In the era before humanity acquired B.E.G., a "Cursed Blade" was the primary means for warriors to combat monsters.
It is a rusted weapon from a bygone era, but better than nothing at all.
Translated from official website

基本的に槐の補佐が役割で、いつも彼を監視している。
魔術師としての才能は無かったが、身体能力は高い。
自分のせいで兄が崩月家に縛られていると知っているため、何があっても自分は槐の味方になると決めている。
極度のブラコンだが兄に恋心を漏らすことはない。
自称妹忍者メイドだが、忍者メイドが何なのかは謎。

The second son of the Houzuki family, the most villainous mage family in Japan.
His talent for magic is the absolute finest in the history of the Houzuki family, making him highly promising for the future.
Mages are inherently evil existences, but Enju has very little interest in good and evil.
He dedicates himself to magic simply out of a desire to unravel the mechanisms of the universe.
Because he has no interest in anything outside of magic, he is considerably naive and detached from the world.
He has an extreme sister complex and has resolved to do anything for the sake of his little sister.
And that is the very reason why he cannot escape from the Houzuki family.
B.E.G.
Letter and Prayer (手紙と祈り)
A fountain pen that grants an object the properties of a name when that name is written onto it.
For example, if you carve the word "Cat" into a piece of wood, a wooden cat is born and will begin to move around freely.
An ability well-suited for infiltration, carrying an underlying aura of betrayal and conspiracy.

魔術の才能は崩月家の歴史でもピカ一であり、将来を有望視されている。
魔術師は本来悪の存在だが、槐は余り善悪に興味が無い。
